svg.title: Variable-speed Cauchy fronts and transported covectors
svg.desc: Base positions X=arsinh(exp(t) sinh(y)) and covectors xi=exp(-t) cosh(X)/cosh(y), for y=-1,0,1 and initial eta=1. Curves are piecewise linear samples at121 equally spaced times, from0 to2. Exact formulas and delta weight are proved in Section7.3.

g.text: Variable speed preserves the flow graph and changes the delta weight
Proof: Section7.3, (CE38)-(CE40). Curves sampled at121 times; exact identities and bounds remain in the text.
